text: หัวหน้าหมู่เก่า
style: Speak natural standard Central Thai (Bangkok) as a native Thai voice actor dubbing a Chinese costume drama; no foreign accent, clear tones, natural rhythm and polite particles only where written. A 58-year-old army veteran of the Qin army, male: rough, hoarse and loud; his voice shakes when he speaks of Line direction (written in Chinese; never read it aloud, speak only the Thai line): 粗啞，極短促，說完就停
